piece.title: String Quartet in C major, Hob.III:77, Op.76 No.3 (“Emperor”)
piece.why: Easy hero: Haydn's “Emperor” hymn, melody in Violin I over a clean four-part chorale accompaniment.

plan.summary: Rule-based plan (no AI): the highest line is treated as the melody and the lowest as the bass; the remaining lines are ranked by how busy they are. Working 4 bars at a time, a line stays with the player who had it while that player still fits it as well as anyone free; otherwise it goes to the free player whose range fits it best. A last phrase shorter than 2 bars joins the one before. A player left without a line doubles the melody or the bass, whichever fits their range better, at an octave that doesn't sound under the bass.
